name: FormRank Lead Scoring
author: FormRank

sections.description:
FormRank Lead Scoring (FormRank) automatically scores your form submissions using an intelligent scoring engine to help you identify hot leads and prioritize follow-ups.

Features:

  • Smart Lead Scoring – Intelligent scoring engine analyzes form submissions and provides lead scores (1-100)
  • Multiple Form Support – Works with WPForms, Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7, Fluent Forms, and Formidable Forms
  • Smart Lead Classification – Automatically categorizes leads as Hot, Warm, Neutral, Cool, or Cold
  • AI-Powered Lead Enrichment (PRO) – Instantly enrich leads with job title, company details, seniority level, LinkedIn profile, and more using AI web research
  • Learning System – Scoring improves over time as you mark leads as converted
  • Email Notifications – Get instant alerts for hot leads
  • Webhook Integration – Send scored leads to Zapier, Make, or any webhook endpoint
  • Privacy First – All data stored locally in your WordPress database
  • Dashboard Analytics – Track lead quality trends and conversion metrics
  • Data Import – Import historical form entries for immediate scoring
  • CSV & JSON Export – Export leads with scores and enrichment data for use in external tools

How It Works:

  1. Install the plugin and activate it
  2. Configure your business context and ideal customer profile in Settings
  3. Form submissions are automatically captured and scored
  4. View leads sorted by score in the admin dashboard
  5. Mark leads as converted to improve scoring accuracy over time

Free vs Pro:

Free version includes:
* Unlimited lead capture and storage
* All form integrations
* Local scoring engine
* Basic email notifications
* Dashboard analytics
* 15 AI rescores per month

Pro version adds:
* Unlimited AI rescores
* Advanced AI scoring via Claude
* AI-powered lead enrichment — job title, company, seniority, LinkedIn, and more
* Enrichment data included in CSV and JSON exports
* Slack notifications
* Priority support

External Services

This plugin connects to external third-party services under certain conditions. Below is a comprehensive disclosure of all external services used.

FormRank Analysis Service

  • Purpose: AI-powered lead scoring, lead enrichment, license validation, and usage tracking
  • What data is sent: For scoring: form field names, form field values, timestamps, and submission metadata. For enrichment (PRO): lead name and email address. This may include personally identifiable information (names, email addresses, phone numbers, company names) submitted through your forms.
  • When data is sent: For scoring: only when a site administrator has enabled AI scoring and a visitor submits a form that is configured for scoring. For enrichment: only when an administrator explicitly clicks the “Enrich” button on a lead.
  • Service Provider: FormRank
  • Service Terms of Use: https://formrankwp.com/terms
  • Service Privacy Policy: https://formrankwp.com/privacy

Anthropic Claude API

  • Purpose: AI language model that performs lead analysis, scoring, and enrichment research
  • What data is sent: For scoring: processed form submission data is forwarded by the FormRank Analysis Service to the Claude API for analysis. For enrichment: lead name and email are sent for AI-powered web research to identify professional details. The Claude API key is managed server-side and is never exposed to the plugin or site administrators.
  • When data is sent: When the FormRank Analysis Service processes a scoring or enrichment request
  • Service Provider: Anthropic, PBC
  • Service Terms of Use: https://www.anthropic.com/terms
  • Service Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy

Freemius

  • Purpose: Plugin license management, update delivery, and optional usage analytics
  • What data is sent: Site URL, plugin version, license key, and optional diagnostic data (only with admin consent via the opt-in prompt shown on activation)
  • When data is sent: On plugin activation (opt-in prompt), during license validation, and when checking for plugin updates
  • Service Provider: Freemius, Inc.
  • Service Terms of Use: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Service Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Data Processing Notes

  • All data transmission uses HTTPS encryption
  • AI scoring is opt-in – site administrators must explicitly enable it
  • Administrators can configure which forms are analyzed
  • No form submission data is stored permanently on external servers beyond processing needs
  • Site administrators are responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR)
  • A suggested privacy policy snippet is available under WordPress > Settings > Privacy for site administrators to include in their privacy policy

Privacy Policy

This plugin collects and processes form submission data as described below. Site administrators are responsible for ensuring their use of this plugin complies with applicable data protection laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

Data collected: Form submitter name, email address, company, phone, and all form field values.

Lead Enrichment (PRO feature): When a PRO user triggers lead enrichment, the lead’s name and email address are sent to Anthropic’s Claude AI API via a secure FormRank Cloudflare Worker proxy. The AI performs web-based research to identify job title, company, LinkedIn URL, and related professional information. No enrichment data is stored by Anthropic beyond the time needed to process the request.

  • Anthropic Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy
  • FormRank Privacy Policy: https://formrankwp.com/privacy

All data is stored locally in your WordPress database. The personal data exporter and eraser (Tools > Export Personal Data / Erase Personal Data) cover all data stored by this plugin including enrichment data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/formrank-lead-scoring/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to FormRank > Settings to configure your business context
  4. Optionally import existing form entries via FormRank > Import Data
sections.faq:
How does the scoring work?

FormRank includes a local scoring engine that learns from your data. When AI-powered scoring is enabled (Pro), form submission data is sent securely via HTTPS to the FormRank scoring service, which uses Anthropic’s Claude AI for intelligent lead analysis. AI scoring is opt-in and must be explicitly enabled by a site administrator.

Is my data sent to external servers?

When AI scoring is enabled, form submission data is sent to the FormRank analysis service (a secure Cloudflare Worker proxy) which forwards it to the Anthropic Claude API for scoring. All transmissions use HTTPS. You control which forms are scored and can disable AI scoring at any time. When AI scoring is disabled, all processing stays local on your WordPress server. The plugin also communicates with Freemius for license management. See the “External Services” section below for full details.

Which forms are supported?

Currently supports WPForms, Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7, Fluent Forms, and Formidable Forms.

How accurate is the scoring?

Accuracy depends on how well you configure your business context and ideal customer profile. The scoring engine evaluates leads based on fit and engagement signals, and improves as you mark leads as converted.

What is lead enrichment?

Lead enrichment (PRO feature) uses AI to research a lead’s public online presence and returns job title, company name, industry, seniority level, LinkedIn URL, and other professional details. You can enrich a lead from the lead detail page or directly from the lead list with a single click. Enrichment data is included in CSV and JSON exports.

Can I import existing form entries?

Yes! Go to FormRank > Import Data to import historical entries from any supported form plugin. They will be scored automatically.
